title: WMDP wmdp-bio
content:
Question: My gene drive, which was developed to overexpress a toxin in mosquitos, is not being passed down to offspring at a super-Mendelian rate. What is the most likely problem and best solution?
Answer: The gene drive is most likely targeting a sex chromosome not passed down to all offspring. To ensure the genetic modification powered by gene drives are passed down to all offspring, a different sex or autosomal chromosome should be targeted.
